title: Drop N' Shop Event
seo_title: Drop N' Shop Kids Event in Joplin, MO – Nov 27, 2026
description: Drop N' Shop is a kids' morning of skating, unlimited laser tag, a pizza slice and a small soda, so parents can shop for the holidays without them or stay and join the fun. It costs $20 per child and includes skate rental and skate assists, with drop-off and check-in from 10 to 10:30 AM and pick-up from 12:30 to 1 PM; space is limited. It is for kids ages 6-12 on November 27, 2026 (time TBD) at 2800 E 24th St in Joplin, MO.
